article.headline: Yoav Berman scores 22 to propel Queens University to 72-57 victory over West Georgia
article.description: — Yoav Berman had 22 points to lead Queens University to a 72-57 victory over West Georgia on Monday night.
article.linkText: Yoav Berman scores 22 to propel Queens University to 72-57 victory over West Georgia

categories.description: Queens University Royals @ West Georgia Wolves

event.description: Queens University Royals @ West Georgia Wolves

keywords: Queens University Royals @ West Georgia Wolves
article.story: CARROLLTON, Ga. -- — Yoav Berman had 22 points to lead Queens University to a 72-57 victory over West Georgia on Monday night. Berman shot 6 of 11 from the field, including 2 for 4 from 3-point range, and went 8 for 8 from the free-throw line for the Royals (18-12, 11-6 Atlantic Sun Conference). Chris Ashby hit four 3-pointers and scored 16. Shelton Williams-Dryden led the way for the Wolves (5-25, 3-14) with a career-high 30 points and seven rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
